name: nomos-solidcash
description: Nomos spend-mandate vault written in SolidCash (Solidity syntax for Bitcoin Cash)

scripts.build: solidc NomosVault.scash -o build/NomosVault.json && solidc StableSwap.scash -o build/StableSwap.json && solidc HashedTimeLock.scash -o build/HashedTimeLock.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node vault.test.mjs && node swap.test.mjs && node htlc.test.mjs
scripts.demo:chipnet: npm run build && node demo.mjs chipnet
scripts.demo:mainnet: npm run build && node demo.mjs mainnet
